notes: κατῆλθον keeps the preverb's 'down' inside its own unit under rule 106: the following ἀπό is rendered 'from', whose gloss does not carry the preverb's sense, so no expressed preposition answers to the particle.

τε is unrepresented under rule 70, the ASV writing only one English conjunction for ὅ τε Σιλᾶς καὶ ὁ Τιμόθεος; four articles before names are unrepresented under rule 23. A reference comparison will report these and that report is not a correction.
εἶναι takes the supplied 'that … was' under rule 85, the complementizer belonging to the non-finite complement the ASV expands into a finite clause.
